from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

router = APIRouter(prefix="/quic/market-feed")

class SubscribeDatagramChannel(BaseModel):
    connection_id: str
    channel_id: str

@router.post("/subscribe")
async def subscribe_datagram_channel(
    payload: SubscribeDatagramChannel,
    quic_hub: QuicDatagramHub = Depends(get_quic_datagram_hub),
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)
):
    conn = quic_hub.get_connection(payload.connection_id)
    if not conn:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="QUIC connection not found")

    quic_hub.bind_channel(conn, payload.channel_id)
    return {"status": "subscribed", "connection_id": payload.connection_id, "channel": payload.channel_id}
